suggestions: I'm grateful for a staging bug that showed up before prod did, saving me from a very bad Monday.
I'm thankful for the mamak still being open after I close out a ticket way past midnight.
I'm grateful for the quiet ten minutes before Fajr when the whole block is still asleep and it's just me and my thoughts.
I'm thankful for a PR that got approved with just one "nice work" and nothing else to fix.
I'm grateful for my mother texting "dah makan?" at exactly the moment I realise I haven't.
I'm thankful for a kedai kopi teh tarik that hits different when the AC in the office finally breaks.
I'm grateful for a git merge conflict that resolved itself cleaner than I expected.
I'm thankful for the rezeki of a car that started on the first try during the haze season.
I'm grateful for a manager who actually reads the Slack message before replying with three paragraphs.
I'm thankful for rain hitting the zinc roof while I'm still half asleep on a Saturday morning.
I'm grateful for an old university friend randomly sending a voice note just to check in.
I'm thankful for a production alert that turned out to be a false positive and not a 2am page.
I'm grateful for the aunty at the warung who remembers my order without me saying a word.
I'm thankful for finishing a sujud and feeling like the day's weight actually lifted a little.
I'm grateful for a payslip landing on time this month when a few friends' companies are delaying theirs.
